label: Bible Study
prompt: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty _____ in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verse: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
note: God sends the storm after the runaway prophet — the sailors are praying long before Jonah is.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my _____, and was with me in the way which I went.
verse: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
note: Jacob heads back to Bethel to build an altar to the God who answered him when he was a fugitive in distress.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a _____ was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
verse: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
note: A stone sealed with the king's own signet covered the lions' den — so no one could change the outcome.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Through faith we understand that the worlds were _____ by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verse: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
note: Creation from nothing visible — the Hall of Faith's very first exhibit is the universe itself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall _____ as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verse: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
note: Moses' farewell song opens softly: 'my speech shall distil as the dew' — and the KJV spells it with a single l.
